title: Fix cmd_gc_run using dummy ArticleMeta for policy evaluation
description: cli/ops.rs cmd_gc_run queries pinned_cids then evaluates each CID against the policy using dummy ArticleMeta (group='unknown', size=0, age=0). Age-based and group-scoped policies always give wrong results. Fix: query actual metadata from log_entries or store, or add runtime warning that CLI GC uses approximate evaluation.
